title: Jim Rickards: America's $40 Trillion Debt Crisis Has Only One Way Out
speaker: Jim Rickards

macro_themes.view: US won't default or do austerity; inflation is the only way to bring the ~125% debt/GDP ratio down, so inflation will persist.
Refining bottlenecks and attacks on Russian refineries keep diesel high, the main inflation driver; Russia deals won't help before midterms.
Bondholders and fixed-income earners lose in inflation; hard assets and prudent leverage win.
AI is a financial bubble (circular/vendor financing); bondholders and many equity investors will be wiped out though the tech stays.
Bullish energy, defense, agriculture, metals and mining, rare earths long run.
US should pivot to Russia to isolate China and get an off-ramp from the Iran war.

calls.reason: Central bank buying puts a soft floor under gold while inflation lingers; holding ~4,200 despite rate and dollar-demand headwinds shows strength, positioned for next leg up.
calls.quote: the gold is positioned for the next leg up. Um but, now is a good time to get in.
